tests.name: L3VPN full config with VRF, PE-CE BGP, and route targets
tests.input:
Show the L3VPN config for customer ACME on NYC-MPLS-PE-01 including VRF, PE-CE routing, and MP-BGP.

--- NYC-MPLS-PE-01 ---
hostname NYC-MPLS-PE-01
!
ip vrf CUST-ACME
 rd 65000:100
 route-target export 65000:100
 route-target import 65000:100
 route-target import 65000:999
!
interface Loopback0
 ip address 10.255.0.10 255.255.255.255
 ip ospf 100 area 0
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1.100
 description CE_ACME-NYC-RTR-01_CID:ACME-NYC-L3VPN-001
 encapsulation dot1Q 100
 ip vrf forwarding CUST-ACME
 ip address 10.100.0.1 255.255.255.252
!
router bgp 65000
 bgp log-neighbor-changes
 !
 address-family vpnv4
  neighbor 10.255.0.11 activate
  neighbor 10.255.0.11 send-community extended
  neighbor 10.255.0.12 activate
  neighbor 10.255.0.12 send-community extended
 !
 address-family ipv4 vrf CUST-ACME
  neighbor 10.100.0.2 remote-as 65100
  neighbor 10.100.0.2 description CE_ACME-NYC-RTR-01
  neighbor 10.100.0.2 password 0 AcmeBgpK3y!
  neighbor 10.100.0.2 activate
  neighbor 10.100.0.2 route-map RM-ACME-CE-IN in
  neighbor 10.100.0.2 route-map RM-ACME-CE-OUT out
  neighbor 10.100.0.2 maximum-prefix 100 80 restart 30
 exit-address-family
!
route-map RM-ACME-CE-IN permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-ACME-ALLOWED
 set community 65000:100
route-map RM-ACME-CE-OUT permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-ACME-DEFAULT
!
ip prefix-list PL-ACME-ALLOWED seq 10 permit 172.20.0.0/16 le 24
ip prefix-list PL-ACME-ALLOWED seq 20 permit 172.21.0.0/16 le 24
ip prefix-list PL-ACME-DEFAULT seq 10 permit 0.0.0.0/0

tests.name: L2VPN VPLS with pseudowire and xconnect
tests.input:
Show the L2VPN/VPLS config for customer GLOBEX between NYC and LAX PEs.

--- NYC-MPLS-PE-01 ---
hostname NYC-MPLS-PE-01
!
l2vpn vfi context VPLS-GLOBEX
 vpn id 200
 autodiscovery bgp signaling ldp
  rd 65000:200
  route-target export 65000:200
  route-target import 65000:200
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/2.200
 description CE_GLOBEX-NYC-SW-01_L2VPN_CID:GLOB-L2-NYC-001
 encapsulation dot1Q 200
 xconnect 10.255.0.20 200 encapsulation mpls
  backup peer 10.255.0.21 200
!
mpls ldp router-id Loopback0
mpls label protocol ldp
!
interface Loopback0
 ip address 10.255.0.10 255.255.255.255

--- LAX-MPLS-PE-01 ---
hostname LAX-MPLS-PE-01
!
l2vpn vfi context VPLS-GLOBEX
 vpn id 200
 autodiscovery bgp signaling ldp
  rd 65000:200
  route-target export 65000:200
  route-target import 65000:200
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/2.200
 description CE_GLOBEX-LAX-SW-01_L2VPN_CID:GLOB-L2-LAX-001
 encapsulation dot1Q 200
 xconnect 10.255.0.10 200 encapsulation mpls
  backup peer 10.255.0.11 200
!
interface Loopback0
 ip address 10.255.0.20 255.255.255.255

tests.name: MPLS TE tunnel with RSVP
tests.input:
Show the MPLS TE tunnel config from CHI-P-01 to NYC-P-01.

--- CHI-P-01 ---
hostname CHI-P-01
!
mpls traffic-eng tunnels
!
interface Loopback0
 ip address 10.255.0.30 255.255.255.255
 ip ospf 100 area 0
!
interface Tunnel100
 description MPLS-TE_TO_NYC-P-01_PRIMARY
 ip unnumbered Loopback0
 tunnel mode mpls traffic-eng
 tunnel destination 10.255.0.31
 tunnel mpls traffic-eng autoroute announce
 tunnel mpls traffic-eng priority 7 7
 tunnel mpls traffic-eng bandwidth 1000000
 tunnel mpls traffic-eng path-option 10 explicit name PATH-CHI-NYC-PRI
 tunnel mpls traffic-eng path-option 20 dynamic
!
interface Tunnel101
 description MPLS-TE_TO_NYC-P-01_BACKUP
 ip unnumbered Loopback0
 tunnel mode mpls traffic-eng
 tunnel destination 10.255.0.31
 tunnel mpls traffic-eng autoroute announce
 tunnel mpls traffic-eng priority 7 7
 tunnel mpls traffic-eng bandwidth 500000
 tunnel mpls traffic-eng path-option 10 explicit name PATH-CHI-NYC-BKP
 tunnel mpls traffic-eng path-option 20 dynamic
!
ip explicit-path name PATH-CHI-NYC-PRI enable
 next-address 10.0.60.2
 next-address 10.0.61.2
 next-address 10.255.0.31
!
ip explicit-path name PATH-CHI-NYC-BKP enable
 next-address 10.0.62.2
 next-address 10.0.63.2
 next-address 10.0.64.2
 next-address 10.255.0.31
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 description CORE_TO_CHI-P-02
 ip address 10.0.60.1 255.255.255.252
 mpls traffic-eng tunnels
 ip rsvp bandwidth 10000000
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 description CORE_TO_DEN-P-01
 ip address 10.0.62.1 255.255.255.252
 mpls traffic-eng tunnels
 ip rsvp bandwidth 10000000

BGP router identifier 10.255.0.10, local AS number 65000

10.255.0.2      4  65000  481029   470112   98210   24w3d    4821

--- config ---
router bgp 65000
 bgp router-id 10.255.0.10
